fields.q: 你的眼神好温柔，让我觉得很安心……
fields.en: Your eyes are so kind. They make me feel safe…
fields.name: 绯亚娜

q.value: 你的眼神好温柔，让我觉得很安心……

en.value: Your eyes are so kind. They make me feel safe…

fields.q: 我会被你吸引，也许是因为你和那个人一样难以捉摸……
fields.en: Maybe the reason I'm drawn to you is because, like that person, you're hard to grasp…
fields.name: 绯亚娜

q.value: 我会被你吸引，也许是因为你和那个人一样难以捉摸……

fields.q: 恋爱对我来说一直有点难懂。也许有你这样的朋友就够了。
fields.en: Romance has always been a bit tough for me to grasp. Maybe a friend like you is all I need.
fields.name: 绯亚娜

fields.q: 战争与痛苦，争斗与仇恨……这些都只让我难过……能避开的话我想避开。
fields.en: War and pain, fighting and hate… All of it just makes me sad… I'd like to avoid those things if I can.
fields.name: 绯亚娜
